move.note: uproot shuffle: roots lift in a wave front-to-back while the trunk leans in and slides; crown lags then settles

burst.note: petals clamp shut over the core, trunk compresses, then petals snap open as the burst fires at contact; crown kicks back

shot.note: crown rears back and flicks forward to fling a shard at contact

shell.note: petals fold down over the trunk and hold (hardening), then reopen

death.note: petals droop, crown tips forward and falls, trunk slumps, tendrils go limp; terminal pose held
